description.en: Declaration a new employee gives when joining, for PF and pension.
description.ta: புதிய பணியாளர் வேலையில் சேரும்போது PF மற்றும் ஓய்வூதியத்திற்காகக் கொடுக்கும் அறிவிப்பு.
description.hi: नई नौकरी में शामिल होते समय PF और पेंशन के लिए दी जाने वाली घोषणा।
description.or: ନୂଆ ଚାକିରିରେ ଯୋଗଦେବା ସମୟରେ PF ଓ ପେନସନ ପାଇଁ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିବା ଘୋଷଣା।

submit_note: Give the signed form to your employer's HR. If you had a UAN at a previous job, keep using the same UAN - don't create a new one.

question.en: Were you in PF (Provident Fund) at any earlier job?

fields.explain: Answer yes if PF was deducted from your salary at any previous employer.

question.en: Were you in the pension scheme (EPS) at an earlier job?

fields.explain: EPS is the Employees' Pension Scheme. If you had PF earlier, you were almost always in EPS too.

question.en: What is your UAN (Universal Account Number) from the earlier job?

fields.explain: The 12-digit UAN stays the same for your whole career. It is on your old salary slip or the EPFO member portal.

label.en: Date of exit from previous job

question.en: When did you leave the previous job?

fields.explain: Your last working day at the earlier employer.

question.en: Are you an international worker (foreign citizen, or Indian who worked abroad under an SSA country)?

fields.explain: Most people answer No. This is for foreign nationals, or Indians who worked in a country that has a social security agreement with India.

question.en: What is your highest education? (for example 12th, B.Com, B.Tech)

documents: Old salary slip showing UAN (if you had PF earlier)
